title: Coventry students celebrate GCSE success as English and Maths results improve
summary: Thousands of Coventry students are celebrating their GCSE results today, with the city seeing encouraging improvements in both English and maths.

title: ‘Bold Start, Bright Futures’, giving Coventry children the Best Start in Life
summary: A launch event is being held on Friday 21st August between 1.30-3.30 pm to tell families all about the Best Start in Life programme in Coventry and what it can offer.

title: Success for Coventry students as 2026 results maintain high standards
summary: Congratulations to Coventry sixth form students who are celebrating their achievements after receiving their provisional A level and vocational qualification results for 2026.

title: Coombe Abbey Park scores highly in national visitor attraction rating
summary: Coombe Abbey Park has been recognised as one of the region’s leading visitor attractions, with a high-scoring rating by VisitEngland.

title: Hidden books to spread the joy of reading
summary: Children and families are being invited to ‘Look for a Book’ when they’re out and about in the city.

title: Communities invited to shape grants programme to support local events
summary: Coventry City Council is looking to hear from communities ahead of the launch of a new grants programme to support community events.
